question: 41 years ago today, Phil Simms threw for 513 yards, still the Giants' single-game record. Eli Manning fell 3 yards short in 2012. How did Simms' record day end?
answer_detail: Simms went 40-of-62 at Cincinnati on Oct. 13, 1985, but threw just one TD and two picks. Of the three 500-yard passing games in Giants history, it's the only loss.
